summary.name: Royal TSX
summary.one_liner: Royal TSX is a remote connection manager for macOS that handles RDP, VNC, SSH, S/FTP and web-based connections from one interface.
use_cases: manage many remote servers from one app
connect to Windows machines over RDP
share connection lists with a team without sharing passwords
tunnel connections through an SSH gateway
store and use credentials from 1Password, LastPass or KeePass
summary.what_it_does: Royal TSX provides a single interface for remote connections over RDP, VNC, SSH-based terminals, S/FTP and web-based interfaces. It offers built-in credential management, and credentials can be kept in a private document while connection lists are shared. Command Tasks and Key Sequence Tasks, plus AppleScript support, automate repetitive work. Documents can be synchronized across users via a network share or cloud storage such as Dropbox, without a SQL back-end. It also integrates with 1Password, LastPass and KeePass and supports customizable UI, tab colors and icons, and macOS dark mode.
notable: Shares connection documents without exposing personal credentials, with credentials kept in password-protected private documents
Syncs documents across users via network share or cloud storage without a SQL database
Royal Server acts as a Secure Gateway and can host documents for a team
Documents are interchangeable with Royal TS (Windows), Royal TSi (iOS) and Royal TSD (Android)
caveats: Free tier is limited to up to 10 connections, 10 credentials and 1 document
Full license is listed at €49.00 with no subscription
Royal Server is a separate product for hosting and gateway features; platform details beyond macOS are for sibling apps
